# 🧰 Reusable Project Templates

Use these templates to make project work repeatable. Replace every placeholder, remove irrelevant sections and never paste credentials, session tokens, customer records or production dumps into GitHub issues or pull requests.

- [API change proposal](api-change.md)
- [Architecture decision record](architecture-decision-record.md)
- [Data dictionary](data-dictionary.md)

## Usage rules
1. Create a copy in the relevant issue, pull request or internal record.
2. Assign an owner and date.
3. Link evidence and related issues.
4. Remove sensitive information before sharing.
5. Update the template when the process changes.
